# Glion Institute of Higher Education

> > Glion Institute of Higher Education: Swiss hospitality management school specializing in luxury hospitality, real estate, and event management education with global industry connections.

Glion offers undergraduate and graduate programs including the Executive Master's in Luxury Management and Guest Experience, preparing students for careers in luxury hospitality, hotel development, real estate investment, and high-end travel sectors. The institution maintains strong partnerships with luxury brands like Louis Vuitton and leading hospitality organizations worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Luxury hospitality management
- Hospitality real estate and property development
- Executive Master's in Luxury Management and Guest Experience
- Luxury brand management and events
- Hotel industry innovation and trends
- Luxury travel and destinations
- Hospitality career development
- Real estate investment and brokerage
- Luxury event management
- Hotel finance and portfolio management
- Blockchain in hospitality
- Student field trips and experiential learning
- Industry partnerships (Louis Vuitton, luxury hotels)
- Luxury consumer behavior and social status
- Hospitality education in Switzerland

## Career Pathways & Programs

- [Your Future in Hospitality & Beyond](https://www.glion.edu/about-us/your-future-in-hospitality-and-beyond): Career outcomes and industry specializations for Glion hospitality graduates
- [How hospitality is perfect for those with a passion for travel](https://www.glion.edu/magazine/how-hospitality-is-perfect-for-those-with-a-passion-for-travel): Student testimonials on combining travel passion with hospitality careers
- [Executive Master's profiles #8 – 'exploring the luxury ecosystem'](https://www.glion.edu/magazine/executive-masters-profiles-8-exploring-luxury-ecosystem): Executive Master's student profile on Luxury Management program experience

## Luxury Management & Industry Insights

- [Putting on a show: Master's students lure big names to luxury panel](https://www.glion.edu/magazine/masters-students-luxury-panel): Master's students organize luxury panel with industry leaders from HLIC
- [Living the dream: why personalization and exclusivity are key to successful luxury events](https://www.glion.edu/magazine/personalization-exclusivity-key-to-successful-luxury-events): Glion graduate Eugénia Moser on luxury event management at Louis Vuitton
- [Status shifts: the changing role of luxury in social hierarchies](https://www.glion.edu/magazine/status-shifts-changing-role-of-luxury-in-social-hierarchies): Dr. Evrim De Groot examines evolving luxury brand status and consumer behavior
- [Inside luxury tour travel companies](https://www.glion.edu/magazine/luxury-tour-travel-companies): Exploring luxury travel industry with insights from Louis Vuitton experts
- [Six hospitality industry trends for 2023 and beyond](https://www.glion.edu/magazine/six-hospitality-industry-trends-for-2023-and-beyond): Guest lecturer Mariana Palmeiro analyzes key 2023 hospitality trends

## Hospitality Real Estate & Investment

- [How to become a real estate investor even if you're just starting out](https://www.glion.edu/magazine/how-to-become-a-real-estate-investor): Beginner's guide to hospitality real estate investing and property careers

- [Start a career in property portfolio management](https://www.glion.edu/magazine/career-property-portfolio-management): Career guide for hospitality property portfolio management professionals
